description: One movement table (content/movement/<id>.json): how a soldier walks, sprints, jumps and tires.

ads_speed_multiplier.description: Walking speed while aiming, in times the walking speed.

air_control_pct.description: Steering in the air, in percent.

body_height_m.description: His height, for headroom and the head bump, in metres.

body_radius_m.description: His body against walls and ledges: its radius, in metres.

foot_radius_m.description: The small circle round his centre that he stands on, so he holds a little past an edge: its radius, in metres.

gravity_m_per_s2.description: Gravity, in metres per second squared.

id.description: The table's id, which is its file's name.

jump_reach_m.description: The highest ledge a jump reaches, in metres.

pull_done_under_m.description: A carry left shorter than this is given all at once, in metres.

pull_share_per_step.description: After a step-up, the share of the carry onto the step left that he gets each step, from 0 to 1.

pull_to_foot_pct.description: The carry brings his centre this share of his foot circle short of the step's edge, in percent.

push_head_on_gate_m_per_s.description: The push turns sideways only when the two close faster than this, in metres per second.

push_height_gap_m.description: Two soldiers whose feet are this far apart in height or more do not push, in metres.

push_keep_going_gate_m_per_s.description: The keep-going limit applies only when he moves faster than this, in metres per second.

push_keep_going_share.description: The most of his own step forward a push may undo, from 0 to 1.

push_most_m_per_step.description: The most one step's push may move him, in metres.

push_radius_m.description: Body size for pushing: its radius, in metres.

push_sideways_share.description: How far a head-on push turns sideways, so the two slide round each other, from 0 to 1.

push_strength_per_s.description: How stiffly two soldiers push apart, per second.

snap_down_m.description: A drop he walks down instead of falling, plus the slope under his foot, in metres.

speed_up_time_to_90pct_s.description: How fast he reaches his speed: the time to 90 percent of it, in seconds.

sprint_multiplier.description: Sprint speed as a share of walking, in times the walking speed.

sprint_returns_at_pct.description: When sprint comes back after running dry, in percent of the bar.

sprint_time_from_full_s.description: Sprint time on a full bar, in seconds.

stamina_refill_time_s.description: Time to refill the bar, in seconds.

step_allowance_m.description: How far above the step-up a top may be and still be walked onto, in metres.

step_up_m.description: What he walks onto without jumping: the highest step, in metres.

stop_time_to_10pct_s.description: How fast he stops: the time down to 10 percent of his speed, in seconds.

version.description: The version of the movement format the file is written in.

walk_speed_m_per_s.description: Walking speed, in metres per second.

title: shamble-movement
